findings.title: Light/dark lightness values swapped for embedded-post author link
findings.body: The original rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)), so the light-theme value is changed from 30% to 70% and the dark-theme value is 30% instead of the complementary 70%. Both themes therefore get the opposite shade from the intended conversion, changing light-theme appearance and giving a too-dark colour on dark themes. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Light/dark lightness values swapped for .custom-message-length
findings.body: The original rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). The change writes dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)), so the light-theme value is changed from 70% to 30% and the dark-theme value is 70% instead of the complementary 30%. Both themes get the opposite shade from the intended conversion. It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)).

findings.title: Group member name lightness changed from 30% to 50% in both themes
findings.body: The original .group-member-info .name rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change replaces it with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), altering the existing light-theme colour from 30% to 50% and using 50% rather than the complementary 70% for dark themes. Consistent with the rest of this PR it should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)).

findings.title: Topic-map heading lightness changed from 20% to 50% in both themes
findings.body: The original .topic-map h3 rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). The change replaces it with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)), altering the existing light-theme colour from 20% to 50% and using 50% rather than the complementary 80% for dark themes (the desktop counterpart correctly uses 20%/80%). It should be dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%)).
